Non-Technical · Electronics & Communication Engineering

Escape room

A fun, mystery-themed room game where teams solve basic puzzle stations to "unlock" the next clue and escape the lab. The puzzles use simple concepts like matching resistor color codes, connecting paper switches, and solving riddles to find hidden lock codes.

DepartmentElectronics & Communication Engineering
CategoryNon-Technical
Venue📍 Department Classroom / Lab
Time & Duration⏰ 10:00 AM onwards (30 minutes)
Format / Team Size👥 Team participation (3 to 4 members)

CHALLENGE STAGES

01

Stage 1: The Color Lock

Calculate a 3-digit number from a resistor color code to unlock a box containing the next clue.

02

Stage 2: Logic Puzzle

Solve a simple logic-gate riddle (AND / OR / NOT) written on a chart to get a door hint.

03

Stage 3: Final Password

Connect two wires on a board to light an LED indicator and reveal the final exit passcode.

RULES AND SCORING

  • ✓ Teams must consist of 3 to 4 members.
  • ✓ No phones or flashlights are allowed inside the room.
  • ✓ Clues must not be torn, hidden, or broken; physical force is never required.
  • ✓ Teams get up to 2 hints from the volunteer inside the room (each hint adds a 2-minute penalty).
  • ✓ The team that escapes in the shortest total time wins.
